Subject: Epoch integration: target windows + retention questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran an internal intake and our legal/procurement team had two quick asks before we lock dates:

1) Can Redwood support a staged migration where we run Epoch in shadow mode for 6 weeks, then move 20% traffic, then 100%? Any suggested cadence?
2) RetailCo requires a 13-month retention snapshot for audit — can you confirm retention/archival options and whether you can provide an export of call-level metadata?

Also looping Jacob from our integration partner who will help with the data handoff.

Thanks — appreciate a short cadence call if needed.

Kelly Nguyen

kelly.nguyen@retailco.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Epoch integration: target windows + retention questions

Kelly — thanks for the note and the doc (got it). Short answers up front, then proposed next steps: 

- Staged migration: Yes. We recommend a 3‑phase runway: 1) Shadow (4–8 wks) to validate outputs and metrics; 2) 20–50% gradual ramp (2 weeks per step depending on traffic); 3) Full cutover with rollback window of 48–72 hrs. We can tune cadence per your QA velocity.
- Retention/export: Redwood Private (VPC) supports customer-managed retention policies; for hosted customers we can provide periodic exports of call-level metadata and a 13-month snapshot export as a CSV. We’ll need to confirm scope (request body, tokens, user identifiers) to ensure compliance.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Quick alignment call Wed 4/4 10am PT — 30m to confirm ramp cadence and who owns each step (RetailCo / Integration partner / Redwood).
2) We’ll attach a baseline mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial migration workbook.
3) Rishi to confirm any compatibility exceptions we should pre-approve (e.g., pinned model variants, cache warmers).

I’ve attached a draft migration workbook — high level — and copied Marissa and Rishi for product/ops details.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Epoch integration: target windows + retention questions

Hi all — quick product notes (output-focused) so expectations are aligned before Wed: 

- Canary routing: we support route-based canaries at the request level; recommend starting with a 5% canary before 20% ramp to watch latency p95 and token-cost delta.
- Model pinning & fallback: if you need deterministic behavior during ramp, request we pin Epoch-v2.0. If latency/cost spike, our smart routing can fallback to Epoch-lite (quantized) for non-sensitive routes. Need RetailCo confirmation on which endpoints can accept degraded variants.
- Cache warming: for interactive flows we provide prefix caching and a pre-warm job; if you expect long-tail prompts we should plan for an extended warm-up window (48 hrs).

Exceptions ask: RetailCo noted they will want a temporary exemption from our default 30-day rolling logs for the 13-month archive. Rishi — can you confirm the exceptions process and whether we need a signed SOC addendum?

I’ll be on the Wed call to map product milestones to your MAP.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Group PM, Product Platform | Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, Kelly Nguyen <kelly.nguyen@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Epoch integration: target windows + retention questions

Marissa / Soojin — quick on exceptions:

- 13-month retention: For hosted customers we can create a project-level export + cold storage export. For an extended retention window beyond default logs we require an Exceptions Request (security review + legal signoff). Typical lead time: 10 business days for review, 2–3 weeks for engineering change if any infra config is needed.
- SOC addendum: If RetailCo requires contract-level changes we escalate to Legal; for most customers a signed addendum + attestation of controls (we can provide our SOC2 artifacts) is sufficient.

Action items for Wed:
- RetailCo to confirm whether they want Redwood-hosted export or will pull snapshots from a S3 export we push.
- Ben to call out any operational runbooks that must be shared with RetailCo/integration partner before shadow.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Reliability | Redwood Inference
